title: Confucius
summary: Confucius lived about 551 to 479 BCE in the state of Lu, now Shandong, and was raised in Qufu, where he taught at a school open to all classes. Around 498 BCE he left Lu with disciples for about thirteen years of travel, was invited back around 484 BCE, and was buried in Qufu. His disciples compiled the Analects, the most reliable record of his ideas, though scholars question how closely it matches his words.

uncertainty.note: Birth c. 551 BCE (some entries give 552, astronomical -551); death 479 BCE (astronomical -478). Both are approximate in the sources.
